_doc: Qwiic / STEMMA QT: a 4-pin JST SH (1.0 mm) I2C connector used by SparkFun, Adafruit and others, so sensors from any of them plug in with one cable. Land pattern for the side-entry SM04B-SRSS-TB, from the socket's centre, the plug going in from +y. kind as in x1c.json.
